## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle compendium by [元曉](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%85%83%E6%9B%89) Wǒnhyo (617–686) treats the doctrinal essence (*zōng yào* 宗要) of the *[2-fascicle Wú liàng shòu jīng](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0060)* (T0360). The work belongs to Wǒnhyo's vast commentarial corpus on the major Mahāyāna scriptures, including parallel *zōng yào* compendia on other major sūtras.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (660 – 686) reflects [元曉](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%85%83%E6%9B%89) Wǒnhyo's mature Silla period.

The Taishō text (T1747) is established on the standard apparatus.
